_comment: Workload definitions. A complete cross-framework run includes BOTH single_e2e and throughput (at least for image cases); a single-request-only run is incomplete. These values are assembled into the generated config's benchmark_defaults, which the harness reads.

single_e2e.description: Steady-state median latency of back-to-back requests after warmup. Metric = client-side wall clock p50 (the only framework-agnostic number). If repeats do not converge, or median exceeds the throughput p50 for the same case, mark the cell an anomaly and withhold the value.

throughput.description: Multi-request server throughput under real concurrency. Records num_requests, concurrency, p50, p95, p99, QPS.

warmup.description: Warmup before measured repeats. Video warms harder (more requests) because it is expensive; LightX2V is capped to 1 warmup request.

_benchmark_defaults_mapping: build_benchmark_config.py maps workloads.throughput -> benchmark_defaults.throughput, workloads.warmup -> benchmark_defaults.warmup, and single_e2e.{image,video}_repeats -> benchmark_defaults.single.{image,video}_repeats.
